name: vera-vscode
description: Bring Vera's IDE features into VS Code / code-server: a Vera sidebar (memory search, enqueue Claude Code tasks) and a one-click command that wires Vera into this workspace's Claude Code as an MCP server.

vera.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Vera server (its HTTP / MCP endpoint).

vera.allow.description: CSV of Vera capability-name prefixes the MCP bridge exposes to Claude Code.

vera.askCapability.description: Capability name the 'Ask Vera' box invokes with {query} (e.g. a memory/search cap). Leave blank to disable.

vera.clientMode.description: Register this VS Code window with Vera as a controllable client (kind=vscode-client): Vera can open files, run commands, drive the terminal and run Claude Code tasks here — Claude uses THIS machine's sign-in.

vera.clientLabel.description: Label shown for this window in Vera's instance list (default: hostname · workspace folder).

vera.clientToken.description: Optional shared secret for the client channel. Sent on register; Vera then requires it on every poll/result.

commands.title: Vera: Connect this workspace (install MCP bridge)
Vera: Enqueue a Claude Code task for this workspace
Vera: Toggle client mode (let Vera control this window)
